hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Let seq be the state settings's 'abilityOptions''s 'sequence'.
Let v be each member in the living party mapped to the id of member.
Let v2 be _ → include with (v, the character ASHE).
Let v3 be _ → include with (v, the character BALFLEAR).
Let v4 be "04".
If v2 and v3, then set v4 to "07".
Otherwise, if v2, then set v4 to "06".
Otherwise, if v3, then set v4 to "05".
Set seq at 0 at 0's 'messageSuffixNo' to v4.
Call arg.
